justifications.durability: the regression guard is not an external one-off script: tests/test_exact_clip_seed_render.py's own test_a_title_without_the_residual_is_refused exercises check_render_receipt against a mutated in-memory record, and a second pair of tests (test_the_null_tally_tells_the_three_glyph_kinds_apart, test_the_tally_drops_a_saddle_outside_the_vessel) rebuilds a panel and reads the glyph counts back off the actual matplotlib axes rather than off the committed receipt, so a renderer regression is caught even if the receipt file goes stale. ruff --select E501 on the delivered benchmarks/exact_clip_seed_amplitude.py reports no violations, consistent with the manifest's claim that four E501s were fixed before staging.
justifications.evidence: I independently reran the gate in the untouched fsa-repair-exact-clip-seed-panels worktree at its recorded commit 9028424f9 (git status clean, HEAD matches the manifest's commits list): `pytest tests/test_exact_clip_seed_render.py` gave 4 passed in 38.93s (node reported 6.22s, same outcome, timing difference only), matching the delivered pytest.log. I extracted docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/exact-clip-seed/render-receipt.json from commit b4371411 via git show and confirmed figure_count=12, residual range 1.1998637468319157e-13..6.711667497659967e-13 (matches the manifest's stated range and the corrected record in commit 9028424f9 exactly), all twelve converged=True, and every poloidal_panel entry carries both an 'analytic' and a 'solved' null_glyphs block. I recomputed sha256 of all twelve committed PNGs from the git blob at b4371411 and every one matches the receipt's recorded sha256. I opened four of the twelve PNGs (weak-rotation-reactor-static reduced and 110-comparison, strong-rotation-compact-static cells-300, moderate-rotation-conventional-static 300-comparison) with the image tool: each title line, both null-coloured triangle markers, the shared-Wb-levels comparison panel, and the black wall outline are present exactly as the receipt and commit message describe. logs/render-only.log's per-row residual list matches the receipt's twelve residuals one-for-one, and logs/negative-control.log shows the declared mutation (stripping 'residual=' from one title) is genuinely refused by the same check the passing gate runs, with negative_control_exit=0 recorded correctly for a check that fails as declared.
justifications.fit: git show --stat on both commits lists exactly the paths in changed_paths (driver, test file, the twelve PNGs plus their six production-route parts/*.json, render-receipt.json, and the two doc records) plus nothing else; no plan, sprint, ticket or stage label appears anywhere in the diff, and function/variable names (null_glyph_tally, _null_sets, _null_caption, _figure_title) are named by mechanism, not by which finding they closed. The second commit (9028424f9) correctly self-corrects a residual bound the worker had first quoted from memory (6.67e-13) against the receipt's actual value (6.71e-13) in both doc records, which is exactly the kind of number-matches-source discipline this review is checking.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the two defects named in the repair commit (F7: no residual/converged stated; F3: production-route error panels drew no nulls at all and comparison panels drew the solved set only) are both independently verified fixed on all twelve panels: every title I read off the rebuilt PNGs states 'residual=... · converged=True' sourced from the row's persisted solver block, and every poloidal panel (all four panels of the 2x2 production-route template, both panels of the comparison template) draws the analytic null set in #3366cc and the solved set in #cc7722 with an in-panel caption naming the colours.
justifications.scope_discipline: only the exact-clip-seed figure directory, its own driver and test file, and the two plan/evidence records are touched; the manifest's follow_ons correctly defer the shared solve-panel template defect (benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py still draws no nulls and no residual on every other directory using it) rather than reaching into it, and correctly note that receipt.json's stale certificate_figure/comparison_figure sha256 values were left alone because the underlying seed measurements are unmodified.
